Diwali 2026 : deshbhar men dipon ke mahaparv dipavli ki dhum dekhne ko mil rahi hai. jharkhand ki rajdhani ranchi men bhi divali ko lekar khas utsah najar aaya... bachchon men tyohar ko lekar jabardast umang dikhi... gharon aur aaspas ke ilakon men sajavat, roshni aur khushiyon ke bich logon ne dipavli ka jashn manaya
